messages.subject: rstudio presentations code block
parts:
I like how there is a box around the code and then a seperate box around the output of the code in the rstudio html5 presentations using markup with knitr.

For ex: 
Slide With Code
========================================================

```{r}
summary(cars)
```

Will produce a box around the code summary(cars) with a slight background color, and then a second box around the output.

I would like to replicate that in using knitr with beamer/latex.

The closest way I can do it now is to write the code twice:

 \begin{frame}[fragile]
<<eval=FALSE>>=
summary(cars)
@

<<echo=FALSE,comment=NA>>=
summary(cars)
@
\end{frame}

I would rather not have to write the code twice for each slide.

Thanks for any advice.

Stephen
